acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies a target that escapes its allowed boundary.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with an escaping target.

acceptances.when: The supplied target escapes its allowed boundary.

acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies a missing target.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with a missing target.

acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies a wrong target.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with a wrong target.

acceptances.given: A target package has not yet been effectively inspected.

oracle.expected: An effective-inspection result is available independently of identity verification.
forbidden: Treating a nominal, substituted, or otherwise ineffective inspection as effective inspection.

acceptances.then: The target package has been effectively inspected independently of identity verification.

acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies an unsupported target.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with an unsupported target.

acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies an illegal target.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with an illegal target.

acceptances.given: Target package identity has not yet been independently verified.

forbidden: Treating target package identity as unverified or inferred without independent verification.

acceptances.then: The target package identity is independently verified.

acceptances.given: A target evaluation request supplies a substituted target.

oracle.expected: Evaluation rejects the target without a successful result.
forbidden: Accepting, inspecting as valid, or continuing with a substituted target.

acceptances.given: The complete current Consumer Manifest and VDD repository callers exist, but bidirectional reconciliation is not established.

oracle.expected: Both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest checks cover all identified VDD callers.
forbidden: Only one direction of reconciliation is performed.
VDD callers are omitted from reconciliation.

acceptances.then: The Consumer Manifest and VDD repository callers are reconciled in both directions.

acceptances.given: The complete current Consumer Manifest and workflow-model-routing repository callers exist, but bidirectional reconciliation is not established.

oracle.expected: Both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest checks cover all identified workflow-model-routing callers.
forbidden: Only one direction of reconciliation is performed.
workflow-model-routing callers are omitted from reconciliation.

acceptances.then: The Consumer Manifest and workflow-model-routing repository callers are reconciled in both directions.

acceptances.given: The complete current Consumer Manifest and Acceptance repository callers exist, but bidirectional reconciliation is not established.

oracle.expected: Both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest checks cover all identified Acceptance callers.
forbidden: Only one direction of reconciliation is performed.
Acceptance callers are omitted from reconciliation.

acceptances.then: The Consumer Manifest and Acceptance repository callers are reconciled in both directions.

acceptances.given: A replay result is being produced and its complete current-state binding has not yet been established.

oracle.expected: The replay result contains or references a complete Current Snapshot sufficient to identify all replay-relevant current state.
forbidden: Replay result is emitted without a complete Current Snapshot binding.
Replay result is bound to a partial or incomplete snapshot.

acceptances.then: A replay result is bound to a complete Current Snapshot.
acceptances.when: A replay result is produced or recorded.

acceptances.given: The replay result exists, but reproducibility from a fresh checkout has not yet been demonstrated.

oracle.expected: Running the replay from a fresh checkout reproduces the recorded result.
forbidden: Replay can only be reproduced from a pre-existing or modified checkout.
A fresh checkout yields a different or unreproducible result without an authorized change.

acceptances.then: The recorded replay result is reproduced from a fresh checkout.
acceptances.when: Replay is executed from a fresh checkout.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise an escaping target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Exercise a missing target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Exercise a wrong target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Exercise a nominal or substituted inspection and observe that it cannot satisfy the effective-inspection oracle.
Exercise an unsupported target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Exercise an illegal target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Exercise an unverified or inferred target identity and observe that it cannot satisfy the identity-verification oracle.
Exercise a substituted target and observe rejection without a successful result.
Omit a VDD caller from either reconciliation direction and observe non-success.
Omit a workflow-model-routing caller from either reconciliation direction and observe non-success.
Omit an Acceptance caller from either reconciliation direction and observe non-success.
Produce a replay result with a partial Current Snapshot and observe non-success.
Replay recorded inputs from a fresh checkout with a changed result and observe non-success.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject escaping targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Escaping target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: An escaping target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject missing targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Missing target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A missing target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject wrong targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Wrong target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A wrong target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Bind effective target inspection to an independently observable result.
slice_hints.state_transition: Uninspected target package to independently effectively inspected target package.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: The inspection result is independently available for the evaluated target.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject unsupported targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unsupported target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: An unsupported target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject illegal targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Illegal target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: An illegal target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Bind target identity to an independently observable verification result.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unverified target identity to independently verified target identity.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Identity verification is independently available for the evaluated target.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reject substituted targets before successful evaluation.
slice_hints.state_transition: Substituted target request to rejected evaluation.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A substituted target cannot produce a successful evaluation result.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete Consumer Manifest with VDD callers in both directions.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unreconciled manifest and VDD call surface to bidirectionally reconciled sets.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Every identified VDD caller is represented in both reconciliation directions.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete Consumer Manifest with workflow-model-routing callers in both directions.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unreconciled manifest and workflow-model-routing call surface to bidirectionally reconciled sets.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Every identified workflow-model-routing caller is represented in both reconciliation directions.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete Consumer Manifest with Acceptance callers in both directions.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unreconciled manifest and Acceptance call surface to bidirectionally reconciled sets.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Every identified Acceptance caller is represented in both reconciliation directions.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Bind every replay result to a complete Current Snapshot.
slice_hints.state_transition: Replay result without a complete current-state binding to replay result with a complete Current Snapshot.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A replay result cannot be emitted without a complete Current Snapshot.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Rebuild original binding identities before replaying from a fresh checkout with those same identities.
slice_hints.state_transition: Recorded replay inputs to reconstructed original binding identities and fresh replay result.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A fresh checkout replay using rebuilt original identities reproduces the recorded result.
